entries.description: Regenerate inventory, scorecard, assessment, and backlog for one exact commit as non-promoting Auditor evidence.
Compute the deterministic scorecard for one exact current commit without persisting audit artifacts or evidence.
List registered DEVAI actions as JSON.
Run a canonical check suite or one named check with fail-closed aggregate output.
Diagnose an adopter repository against its installed DEVAI contracts.
Collect governed evidence from one declared source into harness state.
Record one governed evidence kind through the append-only evidence boundary.
Apply a redaction policy to a record, re-link downstream, and log a redaction event
Render one evidence view from canonical records.
Verify a declared evidence scope, including optional read-only chain-head inspection.
Apply the Architect-owned initialization projection with explicit write consent.
Apply the canonical harness projection with explicit Architect-initiated write consent.
Apply the Owner-owned initialization projection with explicit write consent.
Bind the installed DEVAI package contracts into an adopter repository.
Build the exact segmented bootstrap plan without authorizing a mutation.

Record the Inspector certification transition only through the protected v3 certification provider and its content-addressed evidence sink for one exact candidate; it grants no packaging or publication authority.
Evaluate release eligibility without granting publication authority.
Inspect and record release-runtime drift under the release controller.
Publish the exported evidence bundle for one exact candidate under an Owner-issued one-time authorization and a bound passing offline-verification receipt; it never publishes the product.
Export the prepared candidate and its evidence bundle to local artifacts under Architect authority; it performs no remote effect.

Verify an exported candidate and its evidence bundle without network access and emit a deterministic offline-verification receipt; it persists no state and grants no lifecycle transition or publication authority.
Resolve the release lifecycle plan for one exact candidate from canonical inputs and emit a deterministic plan receipt; it persists no state or evidence.
Record the Inspector preflight_passed state that opens the release lifecycle for one exact candidate against a bound valid plan receipt; it grants no packaging or publication authority.

Purely compose certified candidate release material in memory and expose it only through an injected trusted two-phase ArtifactSink under Architect authority; it performs no remote effect and accepts no pathname destination or npm/tool subprocess.

Dispatch the product publication for one exact candidate under a separate Owner-issued one-time authorization and record publication_dispatched; published evidence never authorizes it and a dispatch is never published.

Report the exact recorded lifecycle head for one candidate and the states verifiable from supplied or located receipts, including published from a verified signed publication receipt; the observation advances, repairs, and revives nothing.
Read release-control status without persisting evidence or state.
Verify post-deployment release state under the release controller.
Summarize tasks and open gaps for one active round.
Execute the authorized round-close transition; never infer release or publication.
Create a governed round gap record through the harness boundary.
List governed gaps for the active round.
Resolve a governed round gap through the harness boundary.
Show one governed round gap.
Create or render Architect-owned round planning material from canonical inputs.
Advance selected ready tasks within one active round through their declared executors.
Seal Architect-owned round material without publishing it.
Read one governed round in place and report its schema-valid canonical status.
Disable opt-in governance tracking for one round; freeze pending events by default and never delete an already published projection.
Record the Owner authorization that activates opt-in governance tracking and bounded public projection for exactly one round.
Report one round's canonical tracking counts and remote projection health as independent axes, without any network call.
Reconcile one round's sealed projection outbox against the remote issue idempotently; never recreate a missing issue implicitly.
Render one canonical repository inventory slice without persistence.
Execute the DB-writing migration sensor with explicit Engineer write consent.
Persist or rebuild declared sensor readings through the harness boundary.
Run one resolved sensor kind or preset; per-kind effect and authority are enforced before execution.
Escalate one round-subordinate task through hidden plumbing.
Finish one round-subordinate task and release its declared resources.
Pause one round-subordinate task on a governed gap.
Add one task to an active round queue through hidden plumbing.
Complete one active-round queue item through hidden plumbing.
List active-round queue items through hidden plumbing.
Select the next ready active-round queue item through hidden plumbing.
Resume one paused round-subordinate task after its governed gap resolves.
Start one round-subordinate task and provision only its declared resources.
Read task and managed-resource status for one active round.
Deterministically classify one SensorReading and record its route; inconclusive always escalates to a human.
